items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Mrs. Garland answered the door... and she says, 'Oh, Mrs. Lewis? She has her baby.'

ctx.x: Well, my sister came home I guess about, oh, about

8:00 o'clock. So when she got home she didn't know, so she came and discovered that she was an aunt. (Laughter) And I had to tell her what happened, how it happened and everything, you know. And this lady had stayed with me all that time, you know, until my sister came home. And then I think my friend Jim Wynn came to pick me up to go to work that night. Yeah, so we didn't even -- I didn't get a chance to notify anybody.

So anyway, when he came to pick me up, the doctor, they were still there. Because this must have happened about 5:30, 5:30 or 6:00 o'clock or something like that, because we used to have to be to work at 8:00 o'clock. But still, it might have been even a little later than that. I'm just guessing now about time. I'm just sort of playing with time now. But I'm remembering that Jim Wynn came and rang the doorbell. Well, he picked me up, you see. He'd pick me up at 7:30. This is a good thing for me to remember that…
